maddeler.e:
تقاضيت (form VI)
# تَقَاضَيْتُ (taqāḍaytu) /ta.qaː.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تَقَاضَيْتَ (taqāḍayta) /ta.qaː.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تَقَاضَيْتِ (taqāḍayti) /ta.qaː.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
